$description: Chart interaction (platform/charts/interaction.js and chart-interaction.css, library wave 9, lane A): the interactive plot's focus border, the ring on the value in focus, the brush of a zoom, dimming, the selected mark and the frame's actions row. Existing roles only.

chart-interaction-focus-border-width.$description: Chart interaction: the interactive plot's border, transparent until it is focused.

chart-interaction-focus-border-color.$description: Chart interaction: the plot's border while it has keyboard focus (focus = border color only).

chart-interaction-focus-radius.$description: Chart interaction: the corners of the plot's focus border.

chart-interaction-actions-gap.$description: Chart interaction: the space between the buttons above the plot (Reset zoom, zoom controls).

chart-interaction-focus-mark-size.$description: Chart interaction: the size of the dot on the value in focus or under the pointer, given as its radius (SVG r; 16px across). A size, not a corner (owner, dot-radius-names-34).

chart-interaction-focus-mark-outline.$description: Chart interaction: the ring of the surface around the dot, so it stands off the line.

chart-interaction-focus-mark-outline-wid.$description: Chart interaction: the width of the ring around the dot.

chart-interaction-brush-background.$description: Chart interaction: the shade of the range marked for a zoom.

chart-interaction-brush-border-color.$description: Chart interaction: the edge of the range marked for a zoom.

chart-interaction-brush-border-width.$description: Chart interaction: the width of the brush's edge.

chart-interaction-dim-opacity.$description: Chart interaction: the opacity of the other series' marks while one value is active.

chart-interaction-selected-outline.$description: Chart interaction: the outline of the selected mark.

chart-interaction-selected-outline-width.$description: Chart interaction: the width of the selected mark's outline.
